title: Identify and confirm vulnerabilities on an ongoing basis
reason: Vulnerabilities are identified on an ongoing basis from three sources: third-party advisories are audited into a snapshot that blocks high and critical ones (RV.1.1), the lint ratchet's bandit rules analyze the repository's own Python on every change (RV.1.2), and SECURITY.md is the disclosure policy with a private reporting channel (RV.1.3); a vulnerability confirmed in our code gets a VULN record.
